     │                                                                                              
[HOME│

[Hist│                                                                                           
ory][│### What IS Chinet?                                                                        
3]   │                                                                                           
     │It all started in 1978 when Randy Suess and Ward Christensen created the world's first     
     │computer bulletin board system - "[CBBS][4]".                                              
     │                                                                                           
     │As the years went by, Randy became interested in Unix systems, and in 1982 he created the  
     │world's first public-access Unix system, then called "wlcrjs". Two years later it became   
     │Chinet. It supported UUCP e-mail and Usenet "netnews" (fed from ihnp4). It ran on one of   
     │the earliest Compaq "portable" with a 4 MHz 8088 processor, 640k of memory, and a 10 meg   
     │hard drive.                                                                                
     │                                                                                           
     │Near this time, Chinet also started using a program called "picospan" to replace its bbs   
     │software. Eventually, "yapp" (Yet Another Picospan Program) replaced picospan and remained 
     │in use until Chinet's migration from Unix shell-based access to web based interfaces in the
     │late 90's. Many believe that yapp is *still* one of the best computer conferencing systems 
     │around.                                                                                    
     │                                                                                           
     │In the early days of Chinet, the Internet was still a research tool, not available to the  
     │general public. If you wanted e-mail and newsgroups, you didn't get an account from an ISP,
     │you got an account on either a university computer or a system like Chinet. E-mail and     
     │newsgroup postings were relayed from one computer to the next (via UUCP), mostly at night, 
     │mostly over regular telephone lines at 1200 or 2400 BAUD. It was rare indeed that your     
     │e-mail would cross a gateway and pass through the then-young Internet.                     
     │                                                                                           
     │In the late 80's, Chinet had between 300 and 600 active users. It sported 12 dialup ports  
     │(remember, this was Randy's *hobby*; most of those users were non-paying "guests") and was 
     │considered one of the main Chicago area hubs.                                              
     │                                                                                           
     │Eventually, the UUCP model became obsolete. More and more companies started getting direct 
     │Internet access, and finally cheap ISPs came into existence. Use of Chinet's dial-up ports 
     │started to shrink, especially when the Chicago-area phone company did away with "call-pak" 
     │(which meant that you had to start paying for connect time by the minute). Also,           
     │e-mail/news users didn't need Chinet any more since their ISPs supplied those functions. In
     │May, 1996, a fire at Chinet HQ almost put Chinet out of business for good. But you know    
     │what they say ... "you can't keep a down man good."                                        
     │                                                                                           
     │Still open to the public, Chinet is now entirely web-based, running [Simple Machines       
     │Forum][5] software on a Debian GNU/Linux system.                                           
─────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

supplies for over 35 years. From writing supplies and paper to shredders and school supplies,
Staples is the [office supply][123] expert. We are a top provider of office chairs, desks, tables &

printers, ink & toner, and more. We have all the tools you need to stay productive and connected,

technology, gaming consoles & accessories, décor, and gift cards.


[Staples has everything you could ever need for school.]

### Back to School Made Easy at Staples

For students and parents, Staples is a one-stop shop for all [school supplies][125]. Parents and
students can find everything they need to succeed, from notebooks and art materials to backpacks and
lunch boxes. Teachers will appreciate our extensive selection of classroom essentials, including
educational materials, classroom decor, organizational tools, and more. [Find your school supply
list][126] & shop for everything you need, all in one place!


[Wireless headphones are essential while traveling.]

### Staples Travel Hub

Whether your next trip is for business or pleasure, [Staples Travel Hub][127] is your new
destination for all things travel. Find luggage and travel accessories, and tech gadgets to make
your trip run smoothly. Visit us in-store to take advantage of our [TSA PreCheck][128] and passport
services.


[Prioritizing wellness throughout your day.]

### Health & Wellness

Staples range of [health & wellness products][129] can enhance your workspace and overall
well-being. Shop ergonomic furniture & tech options, as well as smart watches, candles, essential
oils & more. Our curved whiteboard has an ergonomically crafted shape to prevent strain. And a new
selection of [guided journals][130] are available, with topics including anxiety & productivity.


[Take advantage of Staples EasyRewards and AutoRestock and check another thing off your list for
good.]

rewards on every purchase, plus extra rewards on your chosen bonus categories. Our
[AutoRestock][132] feature ensures you never run out of essential supplies, with easy-to-manage
subscriptions. Whether you prefer to shop in-store or online, we offer flexible options for
shipping, same-day delivery, or in-store pickup.



At Staples, we are here to help you navigate your business, office, and school needs with ease.

# Golden Mirror

──┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  │Arpan FP is successfully bridging the gap between industrial utility and luxury branding. By     
  │combining high-spec materials with precision printing, they’ve turned a disposable item into a   
  │premium touchpoint.                                                                              
  │**Why This Combination Works**:                                                                  
  │***Structural Integrity***: 300 GSM ITC paper provides the “hand-feel” of quality. The thickness 
  │offers natural thermal insulation.                                                               
  │***Visual Depth***: UV Offset printing ensures a deep, saturated black. Because UV ink cures     
  │instantly, it eliminates setoff, keeping the surfaces pristine.                                  
  │***The Royal Finish***: Golden Foil Stamping creates a true mirror-like reflection that metallic 
  │inks cannot replicate.

impressed many globally. Being the first in the world to bring such innovation i.e. “[Magic

dimension to your portfolio. Creating unique and customized paper cups for a movie of such caliber
is a testament to Arpan FP’s creativity and adaptability. This blend of creativity and collaboration
undoubtedly sets us apart in the paper cup industry.

We, **Bengaluru Paper Cups**, are an environment conscious company working as the professional
**manufacturer, distributor and supplier for Paper Cups and Blanks**. With the goal to revolutionize
the paper products industry, we focus on introducing innovative and highly recyclable products. Our
entire array is made using finest **quality ITC Papers**, which itself is a testimony of quality.
Use of such qualitative raw input make our Paper Cups and Blanks suitable for further recycling;
contributing towards environment protection.
We strive to meet all the clients' demands as per the expectations. For our honorable clients, we
offer our whole paper product's range in myriad sizes and designs. Further, to give clients complete
ease while dealing with us, we accept payments via some simple modes.

**Why Our Paper Cups?**

Our hired professionals work with sincerity and honesty so as to meet all the customer's demands,
perfectly. They make fruitful utilization of all the resources for minimize the paper product's
production cost and deliver its benefit to end buyer's via competitive priced products. These can be
**used for coffee, tea, juice, water and many other hot and cold beverages**. Our assortment of

* **Attractive designs**

* **Eco-friendly**
* **Lightweight**
* **Recyclable**
* **Resistance against tear & high temperature**
* **Splendid finish**
  
**Product's Index**

We are into manufacturing, exporting, distributing and supplying an high quality paper products:

* **Paper Cups**
* **Paper Blanks**

We also offer **Paper Cups Raw Material** and **Green Thali Raw Material**.

**Guarantee of Quality**

With the goal to establish ourselves in the roots of the industry, we give high attention towards
making and offering high quality products to honorable clients. Our enterprise has hired experienced
quality controlling personnel so as to look & regulate all the production & post-production tasks
and making sure that remarkable range of Disposable Paper Cups and others comes out. These experts
also gauge entire manufactured collection in our modern quality checking cell to ensure 100%
perfection. Our range is tested in a quality checking cell on the basis of its finish,
eco-friendliness, lightweight etc. Leakage test, paper test and printing test are also done on our
range.

**Primary Competitive Advantages**

We offer a range which is completely biodegradable and is made with great care by our skilled
employees. We invite regular feedback for our durable paper products that are convenient,
disposable, qualitative and offer great value for money. Apart from avant-garde range, following are
our other traits:

* Expertise in paper products industry
* Hardworking personnel
* Honesty in deals
* Market leading rates
* Quality focused approaches

byproduct of sugar production. As one of Bioleader’s core packaging categories, with reliable
factory supply and strict QC, it offers a sustainable, practical, and cost-effective alternative to
plastic and foam for takeaway, catering, and foodservice use.

**Bagasse Food Containers, Clamshell Boxes, Bowls, Plates, Trays, ****Cups**......

✅ **Eco-friendly & Compostable** – Made from renewable plant fiber for sustainable food packaging.
✅ **Heat & Cold Resistant** – Suitable for hot and cold foods, microwave, and freezer use.
✅ **Oil & Moisture Resistant** – Helps reduce leakage and maintain packaging performance.
✅ **Food-Contact Safe** – Hygienic, reliable, and suitable for everyday foodservice use.
✅ **Strong & Durable** – Sturdy enough for takeaway, delivery, and dine-in applications.

#### **Applications:**

📌 **Food & Beverage Industry** – Restaurants, takeout and food delivery.
📌 **Food Packaging** – Supermarkets & ready-to-eat meal packaging.
📌 **Events & Parties** – Weddings, birthdays, corporate events......
📌 **Home & Daily Use** – A sustainable alternative to disposable plastic tableware for everyday
meals.

sustainability needs. Supported by our **large-scale production** and reliable supply system, this
product line helps lower raw material and production costs, offering practical, customizable, and
**cost-effective solutions** for beverage, soup, salad, and takeaway use.

PE, PLA, and Water-Based Aqueous Coating

## Sugarcane Bagasse Tableware Solutions

** [ Sugarcane bagasse tableware ][98] ** is made from renewable sugarcane fiber, a natural
byproduct of sugar production. As one of Bioleader’s core packaging categories, with reliable
factory supply and strict QC, it offers a sustainable, practical, and cost-effective alternative to
plastic and foam for takeaway, catering, and foodservice use.

#### **Product Categories:**

**Bagasse Food Containers, Clamshell Boxes, Bowls, Plates, Trays, ****Cups**......

#### **Key Features:**

✅ **Eco-friendly & Compostable** – Made from renewable plant fiber for sustainable food packaging.
✅ **Heat & Cold Resistant** – Suitable for hot and cold foods, microwave, and freezer use.
✅ **Oil & Moisture Resistant** – Helps reduce leakage and maintain packaging performance.
✅ **Food-Contact Safe** – Hygienic, reliable, and suitable for everyday foodservice use.
✅ **Strong & Durable** – Sturdy enough for takeaway, delivery, and dine-in applications.

#### **Applications:**

📌 **Food & Beverage Industry** – Restaurants, takeout and food delivery.
📌 **Food Packaging** – Supermarkets & ready-to-eat meal packaging.
📌 **Events & Parties** – Weddings, birthdays, corporate events......
📌 **Home & Daily Use** – A sustainable alternative to disposable plastic tableware for everyday
meals.

## Paper Cups & Paper Bowls Solutions

**Bioleader’s paper cups and paper bowls** are available in white paper and kraft paper with **PE,
PLA, and water-based aqueous coating** options to meet different food packaging, performance, and
sustainability needs. Supported by our **large-scale production** and reliable supply system, this
product line helps lower raw material and production costs, offering practical, customizable, and
**cost-effective solutions** for beverage, soup, salad, and takeaway use.

#### **Coating Options: **

PE, PLA, and Water-Based Aqueous Coating

* [**Single-wall Paper Cups**][99] – Ideal for cold beverages.

* [**Soup Paper Bowls**][102] – Disposable bowls for hot soups and stews.

* [**Takeaway Paper Bowls**][104] – For food delivery and takeout.

✅ **Customizable** – Logo printing and branding options available.
✅ **Leak-Resistant & Durable** – Strong structure and water/oil resistance.
✅ **Hot & Cold Use** – Suitable for hot and cold drinks and foods.
✅ **Food-Contact Safe** – Made from safe white or kraft paper materials.
✅ **Multiple Eco Options** – PLA and water-based coating solutions.

📌 **Beverage Service** – Coffee shops, tea stores, juice bars, and cafés.

Tonchant^{®} is started in 2007, growing up while producing various food packing bags, boxes, and
packing tapes, due to excellent quality and service, Tonchant expanded their oversea market
rapidly-annual revenue reached US$50 Million. Years passed, Eco-friendly as a trendy topic became
more and more serious, Tonchant decided to change our enterprise’ strategy, Since 2017, we regrouped
our organizational structure and production equipment to focus on manufacturing biodegradable food
package material, especially for coffee and tea package. we are keen on helping our customers pack
their products with no toxic residue, microplastics, or other pollutants.

Tonchant^{®} is started in 2007, growing up while producing various food packing bags, boxes, and
packing tapes, due to excellent quality and service, Tonchant expanded their oversea market
rapidly-annual revenue reached US$50 Million. Years passed, Eco-friendly as a trendy topic became
more and more serious, Tonchant decided to change our enterprise’ strategy, Since 2017, we regrouped
our organizational structure and production equipment to focus on manufacturing biodegradable food
package material, especially for coffee and tea package. we are keen on helping our customers pack
their products with no toxic residue, microplastics, or other pollutants.

tray, you embrace sustainability and contribute to reducing plastic waste, making a positive impact
on the environment.

[22oz Custom Disposable Paper Coke Cup][136]
Our Paper Coke Cup is crafted from sturdy and durable food-grade paper, ensuring a reliable and
leak-resistant drinking experience.Perfect for parties, picnics, outdoor events, and even daily use,
this cup is suitable for a wide range of cold beverages like soda, juice, iced coffee, and more.    
[[eco friendly lid for cups]][137]
[Rim Roll Paper Hot/Cold Cup Cardbard Lid][138]
The lids are designed to fit snugly on cups, providing a secure closure to prevent spills and leaks.
[[windown hot food box under heat light]][139]
[Disposable Hot Food Box with Transparent Window][140]
By choosing our paper food boxes, you contribute to reducing single-use plastic waste and supporting
eco-friendly practices.
[[12oz double wall coffee cups]][141]

A double-wall formed double wall cups feature great insulation capacity, exquisite appearance and
premium quality. Ensuring you a indelible experience of enjoying your coffee, tea and the likes of
hot drinks.

Such cups are coated with water-based coating instead of traditional plastic coatings. This
eco-friendly alternative reduces environmental impact and promotes sustainability
[[Disposable PET Cold Cups with Lids]][145]

also shatter-resistant, making them a safer alternative to glass cups. In addition, PET is resistant
to odors and flavors, meaning it doesn't affect the taste or aroma of the beverages it holds.
[[Biodegradable Plastic Cups with Lids]][147]
[Biodegradable PLA Clear Cold Cup with Lid][148]
PLA cups, also known as polylactic acid cups, are a type of biodegradable and compostable cups made
from renewable resources like corn starch or sugarcane.

Rectangular paper bowls offer a practical, eco-friendly, and versatile solution for serving food,
making them a popular choice for individuals, businesses, and event organizers looking for an
alternative to traditional plastic or foam bowls.

A paper soup container is a sustainable and eco-friendly packaging solution specifically designed to
hold hot soups and other liquid-based foods.

# Welcome to Fulton Distributing

[ [PowerNet Ordering system] ][18]
[ [Market News] ][19]
[ [Warehouse Tour] ][20]
 
Fulton Distributing is proud to be the independent regional provider for all your cleaning supplies
and equipment and quality food service disposable needs. We pride ourselves on providing solutions
to meet our customers' needs while delivering superior service on quality branded products.
 
We are proud to be the premier local supplier to the Resort, Gaming, Recreational, Country Club,
Maintenance Contractor, Healthcare, Industrial, Agricultural, Foodservice, and Education industries
for over 60 years.
 
We work to create value for our customers. Whether your business is large or small, let Fulton
Distributing be your trusted source for all your Janitorial, Breakroom, and Foodservice disposable
needs.
[Contact Us][21] today to explore the options for Janitorial supplies, food service supplies, and
other quality disposables.
 
****Hours of Operation****

# HuiYou Package - Custom Food Packaging Manufacturer

HuiYou Printing & Packaging helps restaurants, coffee brands, fast food chains, takeaway operators,
bakeries, and retail buyers turn custom packaging into brand memory, customer trust, and
repeat-order supply.

Core capabilities include brand-ready design support, paper packaging manufacturing, custom
printing, 2-5 day sample planning, 100% quality control before shipment, export cartons, pallets,
and shipping coordination.

Popular quote categories: paper cups, cup sleeves, food bowls, lunch boxes, burger boxes, fried
chicken boxes, bakery boxes, takeaway paper bags, labels, and cartons.

For a practical buyer checklist before choosing a supplier, read [Custom Food Packaging Supplier
Checklist][1].

## Representative packaging buyer scenarios

HuiYou highlights common planning scenarios for coffee shop packaging, fast food packaging sets,
restaurant takeaway packaging, and bakery packaging. These are representative market contexts, not
named customer case studies or guaranteed results.

For the full customer success library covering bakery packaging, seafood export cartons, catering
packaging, private label packaging, distributor packaging, and seasonal campaigns, visit [Case
Studies][2].

To request a quote, send product type, size, quantity, artwork status, destination, and timing
through [the homepage quote form][3] or WhatsApp +86 186 0089 0060.

[1]: https://huiyoupackage.com/packaging-insights/custom-food-packaging-supplier-checklist/
[2]: https://huiyoupackage.com/case-studies/
[3]: https://huiyoupackage.com/#quote

**Localhost** is one of the core concepts in networking and software development. Whenever you type
`http://localhost` into a browser or connect to `127.0.0.1` from an application, you are talking to
your own machine via a special network loopback interface.

[localhost]

## What Is Localhost?

**Localhost** is a special hostname that always points back to the current machine. Technically, it
maps to the loopback IP addresses:
* `127.0.0.1` for IPv4
* `::1` for IPv6

When you connect to `localhost`, your network traffic never leaves the device. The data goes from
one process to another through the loopback interface only.

Typical entries in the `hosts` file look like:

`127.0.0.1    localhost
::1          localhost`

Key characteristics of localhost:
* Exists on all modern operating systems.
* Is extremely fast and stable for development and testing.
* Is not reachable from other machines unless specifically bridged.
* Can host multiple services using different ports on the same device.

## What Can Be Established on Localhost?

Localhost acts like a private network just for your machine. You can establish almost any type of
networked service on it.

### Web & Application Servers
* HTTP/HTTPS servers such as Apache, Nginx, and IIS
* Application frameworks such as Node.js/Express, Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, and Rails
* GraphQL and REST APIs

`python -m http.server 8000`

### Databases and Storage Services
* MySQL / MariaDB on `localhost:3306`
* PostgreSQL on `localhost:5432`
* MongoDB on `localhost:27017`
* Redis on `localhost:6379`
* Elasticsearch / OpenSearch on `localhost:9200`

### Microservices and Internal APIs

You can run full local service layouts such as:
* Frontend UI at `http://localhost:3000`
* Backend API at `http://localhost:8000`
* Auth service at `http://localhost:9000`
* Metrics or monitoring at `http://localhost:9090`

### DevOps and Infrastructure Emulators
* Local Kubernetes clusters with kind, minikube, or k3d
* Docker containers exposing ports only on localhost
* Message brokers such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, and NATS for async testing

## What Can Be Installed on Localhost?

Essentially any server-side software supported by your OS can be installed and bound exclusively to
localhost.

### Local Web Stacks
* **XAMPP / WAMP / MAMP / Laragon** for Apache, PHP, and MySQL bundles
* **LAMP / LEMP** for Linux + Apache/Nginx + MySQL + PHP
* **Node.js** with Express, Next.js, Nuxt, and similar frameworks
* **Python** frameworks such as Flask, Django, and FastAPI
* **Java** runtimes such as Tomcat, Jetty, Spring Boot, and Quarkus
* **.NET** apps via ASP.NET Core and Kestrel

### Data and Messaging
* Relational DBs: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server developer edition
* NoSQL: MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, CouchDB
* Search: Elasticsearch, Solr
* Queues: RabbitMQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ

### Developer Tools and Dashboards
* phpMyAdmin, Adminer, pgAdmin, Mongo Express
* Grafana, Prometheus UI, Kibana dashboards
* Swagger and OpenAPI interfaces for API testing
* Local documentation servers such as Docusaurus and MkDocs

## What Can Be Done on Localhost?

Localhost is a safe playground for almost all kinds of development and testing.

### Application Development
* Build full-stack apps without deploying to a remote server.
* Debug complex flows such as authentication, payments, and webhooks.
* Simulate production-like setups using Docker Compose or local VMs.

### Testing and QA
* Run unit, integration, and end-to-end tests against local services.
* Load test APIs before exposing them publicly.
* Experiment with failure scenarios and service restarts.

### Learning and Training
* Practice web development with zero hosting cost.
* Learn databases and SQL queries locally.
* Study networking, reverse proxies, SSL, and security configurations.

### Personal Tools
* Run private dashboards, notes, and self-hosted helpers.
* Host local-only services for privacy-focused workflows.

## Which Programs Run on Which Port?

Ports are numbered channels for network data. Many services use well-known defaults, but most of
them can be customized.

───────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────
Port       │Typical Service on Localhost                 │Example                
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
80         │HTTP web server such as Apache, Nginx, or IIS│`http://localhost/`    
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
443        │HTTPS web server                             │`https://localhost/`   
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
3000       │React, Next.js, and Node dev servers         │`http://localhost:3000`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
4200       │Angular CLI dev server                       │`http://localhost:4200`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
5000 / 8000│Flask and Django dev servers                 │`http://localhost:8000`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
8080       │Alternative HTTP and Java app servers        │`http://localhost:8080`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
8086       │InfluxDB HTTP API                            │`http://localhost:8086`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
3306       │MySQL / MariaDB database                     │`localhost:3306`       
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
5432       │PostgreSQL database                          │`localhost:5432`       
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
6379       │Redis                                        │`localhost:6379`       
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
27017      │MongoDB                                      │`localhost:27017`      
───────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────

To see what is currently listening on which port:

`# Windows
netstat -aon | find "LISTEN"

# Linux / macOS
sudo lsof -i -P -n | grep LISTEN`

## Can I Broadcast to the World from Localhost?

Directly, no. Localhost is only visible to your own machine. However, you can reconfigure services
so they are no longer bound only to localhost.

Typical binding options:
* `127.0.0.1` for pure local-only access
* `0.0.0.0` for listening on all network interfaces
* A specific LAN IP such as `192.168.1.10` for local network access

`app.listen(3000, '127.0.0.1');
app.listen(3000, '0.0.0.0');`

To expose something beyond localhost you usually also need:
* Router port forwarding
* Firewall rules on both the OS and the router
* A domain if you want a stable public address
* Real security with HTTPS, authentication, and access control

For development, it is usually safer to keep services bound to localhost and use tunnel tools like
ngrok or Cloudflare Tunnel when outside access is needed.

## Operating Systems and Localhost

Localhost exists everywhere, but the related tools and config files differ.

### Windows
* `hosts` file: `C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts`
* Loopback IPs: `127.0.0.1` and `::1`
* Useful tools: Command Prompt, PowerS

**Localhost** is one of the core concepts in networking and software development. Whenever you type
`http://localhost` into a browser or connect to `127.0.0.1` from an application, you are talking to
your own machine via a special network loopback interface.

[localhost]

## What Is Localhost?

**Localhost** is a special hostname that always points back to the current machine. Technically, it
maps to the loopback IP addresses:
* `127.0.0.1` for IPv4
* `::1` for IPv6

When you connect to `localhost`, your network traffic never leaves the device. The data goes from
one process to another through the loopback interface only.

Typical entries in the `hosts` file look like:

`127.0.0.1    localhost
::1          localhost`

Key characteristics of localhost:
* Exists on all modern operating systems.
* Is extremely fast and stable for development and testing.
* Is not reachable from other machines unless specifically bridged.
* Can host multiple services using different ports on the same device.

## What Can Be Established on Localhost?

Localhost acts like a private network just for your machine. You can establish almost any type of
networked service on it.

### Web & Application Servers
* HTTP/HTTPS servers such as Apache, Nginx, and IIS
* Application frameworks such as Node.js/Express, Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, and Rails
* GraphQL and REST APIs

`python -m http.server 8000`

### Databases and Storage Services
* MySQL / MariaDB on `localhost:3306`
* PostgreSQL on `localhost:5432`
* MongoDB on `localhost:27017`
* Redis on `localhost:6379`
* Elasticsearch / OpenSearch on `localhost:9200`

### Microservices and Internal APIs

You can run full local service layouts such as:
* Frontend UI at `http://localhost:3000`
* Backend API at `http://localhost:8000`
* Auth service at `http://localhost:9000`
* Metrics or monitoring at `http://localhost:9090`

### DevOps and Infrastructure Emulators
* Local Kubernetes clusters with kind, minikube, or k3d
* Docker containers exposing ports only on localhost
* Message brokers such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, and NATS for async testing

## What Can Be Installed on Localhost?

Essentially any server-side software supported by your OS can be installed and bound exclusively to
localhost.

### Local Web Stacks
* **XAMPP / WAMP / MAMP / Laragon** for Apache, PHP, and MySQL bundles
* **LAMP / LEMP** for Linux + Apache/Nginx + MySQL + PHP
* **Node.js** with Express, Next.js, Nuxt, and similar frameworks
* **Python** frameworks such as Flask, Django, and FastAPI
* **Java** runtimes such as Tomcat, Jetty, Spring Boot, and Quarkus
* **.NET** apps via ASP.NET Core and Kestrel

### Data and Messaging
* Relational DBs: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server developer edition
* NoSQL: MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, CouchDB
* Search: Elasticsearch, Solr
* Queues: RabbitMQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ

### Developer Tools and Dashboards
* phpMyAdmin, Adminer, pgAdmin, Mongo Express
* Grafana, Prometheus UI, Kibana dashboards
* Swagger and OpenAPI interfaces for API testing
* Local documentation servers such as Docusaurus and MkDocs

## What Can Be Done on Localhost?

Localhost is a safe playground for almost all kinds of development and testing.

### Application Development
* Build full-stack apps without deploying to a remote server.
* Debug complex flows such as authentication, payments, and webhooks.
* Simulate production-like setups using Docker Compose or local VMs.

### Testing and QA
* Run unit, integration, and end-to-end tests against local services.
* Load test APIs before exposing them publicly.
* Experiment with failure scenarios and service restarts.

### Learning and Training
* Practice web development with zero hosting cost.
* Learn databases and SQL queries locally.
* Study networking, reverse proxies, SSL, and security configurations.

### Personal Tools
* Run private dashboards, notes, and self-hosted helpers.
* Host local-only services for privacy-focused workflows.

## Which Programs Run on Which Port?

Ports are numbered channels for network data. Many services use well-known defaults, but most of
them can be customized.

───────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────
Port       │Typical Service on Localhost                 │Example                
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
80         │HTTP web server such as Apache, Nginx, or IIS│`http://localhost/`    
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
443        │HTTPS web server                             │`https://localhost/`   
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
3000       │React, Next.js, and Node dev servers         │`http://localhost:3000`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
4200       │Angular CLI dev server                       │`http://localhost:4200`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
5000 / 8000│Flask and Django dev servers                 │`http://localhost:8000`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
8080       │Alternative HTTP and Java app servers        │`http://localhost:8080`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
8086       │InfluxDB HTTP API                            │`http://localhost:8086`
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
3306       │MySQL / MariaDB database                     │`localhost:3306`       
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
5432       │PostgreSQL database                          │`localhost:5432`       
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
6379       │Redis                                        │`localhost:6379`       
───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────
27017      │MongoDB                                      │`localhost:27017`      
───────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────

To see what is currently listening on which port:

`# Windows
netstat -aon | find "LISTEN"

# Linux / macOS
sudo lsof -i -P -n | grep LISTEN`

## Can I Broadcast to the World from Localhost?

Directly, no. Localhost is only visible to your own machine. However, you can reconfigure services
so they are no longer bound only to localhost.

Typical binding options:
* `127.0.0.1` for pure local-only access
* `0.0.0.0` for listening on all network interfaces
* A specific LAN IP such as `192.168.1.10` for local network access

`app.listen(3000, '127.0.0.1');
app.listen(3000, '0.0.0.0');`

To expose something beyond localhost you usually also need:
* Router port forwarding
* Firewall rules on both the OS and the router
* A domain if you want a stable public address
* Real security with HTTPS, authentication, and access control

For development, it is usually safer to keep services bound to localhost and use tunnel tools like
ngrok or Cloudflare Tunnel when outside access is needed.

## Operating Systems and Localhost

Localhost exists everywhere, but the related tools and config files differ.

### Windows
* `hosts` file: `C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts`
* Loopback IPs: `127.0.0.1` and `::1`
* Useful tools: Command Prompt, PowerS

Is your paper cup recyclable?

is here to help. Simply reach out to our customer support, and we will guide you through the
customization process. We can provide you with design templates, specifications, and instructions on
how to submit your artwork. Our goal is to ensure that your paper cups reflect your brand identity

you to bring your vision to life on the paper cups.

What if I have an issue with my order or need to return/exchange the paper cups?

cups, we are here to assist you. Please reach out to our customer support team as soon as possible,
providing details about the problem or the reason for the return/exchange. We will guide you through

arrange for a replacement, refund, or exchange, ensuring that you receive the correct or
satisfactory products. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we are committed to resolving any

## About Mpacks USA

Mpacks USA is a trusted name in eco-friendly food packaging, brought to you by **Mahalaxmi Flexible
Packaging**—a leading Indian manufacturer with decades of expertise in high-quality packaging
solutions. Designed for **restaurants, cloud kitchens, QSRs, and food delivery brands**, Mpacks
combines sustainability, functionality, and branding potential to meet the evolving demands of the
food service industry.

With a strong global export presence and a **local office in Albany, New York**, Mpacks USA is
committed to serving the U.S. market with **direct sourcing, competitive pricing, and reliable
supply chain partnerships**.

### **Premium, Eco-Friendly Food Packaging**

Mpacks specializes in **100% food-safe, paper-based packaging** that is both sustainable and
customisable. Our products are designed to enhance your brand while reducing environmental impact.

## Printer Compatibility

Most modern printers work using OpenPrinting software without additional drivers. We also host a
compatibility database for legacy printers supported by free software drivers.

programs.

ubiquitous printing standard.

OpenPrinting is dedicated to providing open-source printing solutions for Linux, Unix, and other
operating systems. Explore drivers, tools, and resources to enhance your printing experience.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What products does Papacko manufacture?
Papacko specializes in eco-friendly paper packaging — including paper cups, lids, food containers,
and takeaway boxes for cafés, restaurants, and sustainable foodservice brands.
Do you offer custom branding or OEM service?
Yes, Papacko provides full OEM and custom printing options. We can customize your logo, color, size,
and material to match your brand and sustainability requirements.
What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
Our standard MOQ starts from 10,000 pieces per item or design, depending on the specific product
type and customization level.
Are your products biodegradable or compostable?
Absolutely. All Papacko products are made from renewable, biodegradable, and compostable paper
materials that comply with FSC and international environmental standards.
Do you export internationally?
Yes, Papacko serves global clients and provides complete export documentation with flexible shipping
solutions — by sea, air, or express courier.
Can I get samples before placing an order?
Of course. Samples are available upon request so you can check product quality, printing finish, and
packaging design before mass production.

# About

Papercups is an open source live customer chat web app written in Elixir. We offer a hosted version
at [app.papercups.io][33].

You can check out how our chat widget looks and play around with customizing it on our [demo
page][34]. The chat widget component is also open sourced at
[github.com/papercups-io/chat-widget][35].

## Philosophy[#][36]

We wanted to make a self-hosted version of tools like Intercom and Drift for companies that have
privacy and security concerns about having customer data going to third party services. We’re
starting with chat right now but we want to expand into all forms of customer communication like
email campaigns and push notifications.

Stay tuned! We'll be posting a more detailed roadmap soon 🤓

## Features[#][37]
* **Custom chat widget** - a customizable chat widget you can embed on your website to talk to your
  customers
* **React support** - embed the chat widget as a [React component][38], or a simple [HTML
  snippet][39]
* **React Native support (alpha)** - embed the chat widget in your [React Native][40] app
* **Flutter support (beta)** - embed the chat widget in your [Flutter][41] app (courtesy of
  @aguilaair ❤️)
* **Slack integration** - connect with Slack, so you can view and reply to messages directly from a
  Slack channel
* **Mattermost integration** - connect with [Mattermost][42], so you can view and reply to messages
  directly from a Mattermost channel
* **Gmail integration** - link your support Gmail account to sync messages and reply to emails
  directly from Papercups
* **SMS integration** - reply to incoming SMS messages directly from Papercups
* **GitHub integration** - link your GitHub organization to Papercups to easily create issues and
  notify customers when issues are closed
* **Markdown and emoji support** - use markdown and emoji to add character to your messages
* **Invite your team** - send invite links to your teammates to join your account
* **Conversation management** - close, assign, and prioritize conversations
* **Private notes** - send private notes that you share with your team
* **Customer and conversation tags** - organize your customers and conversations with custom tags
  and labels
* **@ mentions** - notify your teammates about important messages
* **Saved replies** - create text snippets for responses to common inquiries to streamline your
  workflow
* **Live session viewing** - watch how your customers are interacting with your webpage in realtime
* **Built on Elixir** - optimized for responsiveness, fault-tolerance, and support for realtime
  updates

## Demo[#][43]

We set up a [simple page][44] that demonstrates how Papercups works.

Try sending us a message to see what the chat experience is like!

## Blog[#][45]

Check out our [blog][46] for more updates and learnings

## Contributing[#][47]

We ❤️ contributions big or small. See [CONTRIBUTING.md][48] for a guide on how to get started.

## Get in touch[#][49]

Come say hi to us on [Slack][50]! 👋

* **Slack integration** - connect with Slack, so you can view and reply to messages directly from a
  Slack channel
* **Mattermost integration** - connect with [Mattermost][42], so you can view and reply to messages
  directly from a Mattermost channel
* **Gmail integration** - link your support Gmail account to sync messages and reply to emails
  directly from Papercups
* **SMS integration** - reply to incoming SMS messages directly from Papercups
* **GitHub integration** - link your GitHub organization to Papercups to easily create issues and
  notify customers when issues are closed
* **Markdown and emoji support** - use markdown and emoji to add character to your messages
* **Invite your team** - send invite links to your teammates to join your account
* **Conversation management** - close, assign, and prioritize conversations
* **Private notes** - send private notes that you share with your team
* **Customer and conversation tags** - organize your customers and conversations with custom tags
  and labels
* **@ mentions** - notify your teammates about important messages
* **Saved replies** - create text snippets for responses to common inquiries to streamline your
  workflow
* **Live session viewing** - watch how your customers are interacting with your webpage in realtime
* **Built on Elixir** - optimized for responsiveness, fault-tolerance, and support for realtime
  updates

## Demo[#][43]

We set up a [simple page][44] that demonstrates how Papercups works.

Try sending us a message to see what the chat experience is like!

## Blog[#][45]

Check out our [blog][46] for more updates and learnings

## Contributing[#][47]

We ❤️ contributions big or small. See [CONTRIBUTING.md][48] for a guide on how to get started.

## Get in touch[#][49]

Come say hi to us on [Slack][50]! 👋

# Paper.io 2 online game

Paper.io 2 is a sequel to what might be the most popular mobile game played by people from all
around the world. Its simple premise, flawless execution and great optimization made it extremely
appealing to both hardcore gamers and regular users who’s devices aren’t always equipped with the
latest hardware.

At its core this is definitely a casual game: after all, all you need to do is steer a colored
square on a blank sheet of paper, covering it with paint, effectively identifying your captured
territories. Start a line somewhere outside of your area, make a full circle and whatever you
outlined will be yours. The difficult part is avoiding attacks from your enemies – a chunk of land
is equally easy to capture for several players, so how the round plays out depends solely on the
skills, wit and strategy of everyone involved.

To make things even more complicated, Paper.io 2 is also a browser game which allows laptop and
desktop users to join the fun wherever they are. Even if you don’t have an internet connection,
there is a way for one player to enjoy all the same mechanics, only he or she would be competing
with AI. It might be less intense, but is still a great way to kill some time when you’re bored.

Among the thousands of IO games this one stands out because of its tight gameplay that combines
action with tactics. The fact that the visuals and the play style are inspired by some of the most
renowned classic arcade titles helps too. Basically, you can be a stay at home mom, a hardened MMO
player or schoolkid in an IT class – chances are, you will enjoy the experience and have fun in
multiplayer battles.

What started as an indie game became a worldwide phenomenon and Paper.io 2 is its rightful
successor. The graphics are still colorful and smooth, the controls are responsive and the gameplay
is better than ever, so now is a great time to check it out if you haven’t already!

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# Hot beverage paper cups for coffee services, foodservice businesses and vending operators.

ABOUT

## Your Business Deserves 
## Superior Service

 

Every element of your food and beverage  program matters. Your guests recognize and demand quality
in every aspect and  your hot beverage cups are important. 


With more than four decades of experience, Superior Cup produces the highest quality paper cups for
businesses across the nation. 


We pride ourselves on reliability, 100% customer focus and making the best cups in America!
 

[Superior_Cup_Manual_Concorde_12oz_COFFEE.png]

## What Makes the Superior Difference? 

[Superior_Cup_icon.png]

### Quality


It all starts with the best raw materials. Every cup is made with the highest quality, heavy caliper
paper that meets our rigorous specifications.  

[Superior_Cup_icon3.png]

### Features


Our exclusive Concorde design, 360° rim design, customizing capabilities and manufacturing equipment

## Custom Printed Paper Cups – Made for Your Brand

**UNICUP is one of the leading manufacturers of custom printed paper cups.** Since 2007 we have been
producing high-quality branded cups that help businesses strengthen their image and connect with
customers. Every order is handled with care, ensuring top quality products and professional service
from start to finish.

**Paper cups are more than just drinkware – they are a powerful advertising tool.** By adding your
logo, graphics, or message, every cup becomes a mini billboard in your customer’s hands. Use them to
promote your brand, share discounts, highlight events, or direct people to your social media
channels with QR codes or unique offers.

Our cups are designed for durability and comfort. With double-wall and insulated options, hot drinks
stay warm longer while hands remain protected. We also provide **free design support** and easy
online customization tools to help you create the perfect look for your brand.

UNICUP offers a wide range of customization options: logos, slogans, taglines, and full-color prints
matched to your brand palette. Whether you need a small batch or large-scale production, we deliver
fast – with **nationwide shipping across the USA**.

## Custom Printed Paper Cups – Made for Your Brand

**UNICUP is one of the leading manufacturers of custom printed paper cups.** Since 2007 we have been
producing high-quality branded cups that help businesses strengthen their image and connect with
customers. Every order is handled with care, ensuring top quality products and professional service
from start to finish.

**Paper cups are more than just drinkware – they are a powerful advertising tool.** By adding your
logo, graphics, or message, every cup becomes a mini billboard in your customer’s hands. Use them to
promote your brand, share discounts, highlight events, or direct people to your social media
channels with QR codes or unique offers.

Our cups are designed for durability and comfort. With double-wall and insulated options, hot drinks
stay warm longer while hands remain protected. We also provide **free design support** and easy
online customization tools to help you create the perfect look for your brand.

UNICUP offers a wide range of customization options: logos, slogans, taglines, and full-color prints
matched to your brand palette. Whether you need a small batch or large-scale production, we deliver
fast – with **nationwide shipping across the USA**.

# Empowering Workspace Recycling

### **Helping Facilities Managers & Sustainability Managers globally, to promote & increase
### recycling at work, achieve sustainability goals and reduce environmental impact.**



### **We provide smart, customised & innovative solutions that help:**
* Drive Behavioural Change
* Increase Recycling
* Decrease Contaminated Waste
* Reduce Carbon Footprint
* Save Time & Labour


### [Unisort iQ][127] Workplace Waste Intelligence

**Turn waste data into measurable performance improvement**
* Capture waste data digitally at source
* Identify contamination areas
* Track recycling performance across sites
* Generate clear recycling & compliance insights

Digital waste tracking: **Mandatory from October 2026**

**[Visit the Unisort iQ page >][128]**

### **Don’t just take our word for it:**

#### 52% General Waste Reduction for NatWest

I just want to share some positive feedback with regards to our waste behaviours on site since we
collaborated. **Our general waste has reduced by 52%** which is a remarkable achievement!  The ease
of separation is helping staff dispose of waste without contamination. Thanks as always! ”


[**Read this case study >**][129]

**— David McManus, Senior Facilities Manager**

#### You have been a supplier for our office recycling stations before and therefore we trusted that
#### the quality was on point.

I was also **impressed with the team** coming to the lounge spaces to help draw up a **customisable
solution** that worked for us. The team have been **quick to respond** to our queries, providing
**timely quotations and mock ups**. Max has provided useful **guidance on waste separation
regulations** and how this would apply to us ”

**— British Airways**

#### The Unisort Recycling Stations at Wellington College represent a major sustainability
#### milestone.

The Unisort Recycling Stations at Wellington College represent a major sustainability milestone. The
team provided a **custom solution** that respects our historic architecture while **improving
recycling usability** across the college. By encouraging correct waste disposal habits, **recycling
rates have notably increased**. Additionally, the Unisort continuous liner system **has cut plastic
use and CO₂ emissions**, supporting our environmental goals with tangible results.”


*[**Read this case study >**][130]*

**— Graham Heffer, Domestic Services Manager**

#### We reduced our contamination rate from 85% to just 7%

within a few months after implementing **Unisort Aspire Stations**. ” 


[**Read this case study >**][131]

****

#### Great designs of your products.

My experience has been positive and I **found everyone to be responsive** and keen to listen to our
requests. We’ve had really good feedback so far so looking forward to more work with yourselves 😊”

**— Dain Robinson - Sustainability Manager, Deloitte**

#### Helpful, professional, quick in response.

Kept to time promised, exactly what was required from order. **Great customer service**. ”


[**Read this case study >**][132]

**— Facilities Manager, H&M**

* Convenient placement with waste streams in one station
* Specific waste streams. Eliminate ‘Mixed Recycling’

### Big News — We're Expanding to Los Angeles

][31]

We heard you. Every order, every reorder, every phone call asking if we can handle more volume — we
heard all of it. And first, thank you. Your business is the reason we're able to say what I'm about
to say. We're opening a second facility in Los Angeles. 60,000 square feet. Our manufacturing roots
will always be in Huntington Beach — Surf City USA. It would probably help if I actually knew how to
surf, but hey, you never know. Maybe one day. ### What This Means for Our Capacity Right now, our
Huntington Beach facility is dialed in for short-run printing and custom orders. That's not
changing. If you're ordering 25 custom cups for your event or a few hundred for your coffee shop,
your order is still coming off the same production line, same quality, same team. No interruption.
The LA facility is a different animal. We're bringing in new cup-forming machines that are on
another level — German-engineered equipment built for speed and precision. We're adding a web press
for high-volume runs: franchises, national hotel chains, large-scale retail. And we're going to
die-cut our own cardstock in-house, which means we control every step from raw material to finished
product under our own roof. ### A National Retailer Picked Us Up I can't name them yet — NDA keeps
that under wraps for now. But a very well-known national retailer has started carrying our food
containers in their stores. That's all I can say right now. When the time comes, you'll hear about
it here first. ### New Trade Department for Brokers This one's been a long time coming. We're
building a dedicated Trade Department specifically for brokers and resellers. Special pricing tiers,
dedicated support, marketing tools, templates, tutorials — everything you need to sell our products
under your own operation. If you're a broker or distributor, this is going to be your lane. ### Jobs
and Growth This expansion means jobs. Real ones. We're going to be hiring across the board —
production, logistics, quality control, sales. Growing the team is something I take seriously. The
people who build this stuff every day are the backbone of this company, and bringing more folks into
the operation is one of the best parts of scaling up. ### AI and Robotics on the Production Floor
Last thing, and this one matters to me personally. We're investing in AI-powered quality control —
systems that can identify defects the human eye misses. Consistency at scale is everything in
manufacturing, and this technology makes sure every single unit meets spec before it ships. We're
also bringing in robotic systems for the most dangerous tasks on the floor. If a machine can handle
the job that puts a person at risk, then the machine should be doing it. Period. The goal is simple:
better products, safer people. ### What's Next We're not slowing down. Huntington Beach stays home
base. LA gives us the muscle to compete at the national level. And we're going to keep building this
company the same way we started — factory direct, no middlemen, transparent pricing, and quality you
can hold in your hand. Stay tuned. — Aram US Paper Cup Factory Huntington Beach, CA

[Read More →][32]
[
[Paper Cups V2 Launch]
][33]
[

### We're Live — US Paper Cup Factory V2 is Here

][34]

Not gonna sugarcoat it — V1 was rough around the edges. It worked, but it wasn't what I wanted to
put in front of you. So we went back in, rebuilt the whole thing from the ground up, and now we're
running on a platform that actually matches the quality of what comes off our production floor.
Here's what changed and why it matters to you: ### Checkout That Doesn't Fight You The old flow had
too many steps and too much friction. The new storefront is fast — add to cart, pay, done. No
spinning wheels, no page reloads, no "did my order go through?" We built this for people who order
in bulk and don't have time to babysit a checkout page. ### Tax-Exempt Accounts for Resellers If
you've got a valid Reseller Permit, upload it once and you're done. Sales tax drops off
automatically on every future order. No more emailing us PDFs, no more manual adjustments. This was
the number one request from our wholesale buyers and it's finally baked in. ### Net 15, 30, and
45-Day Terms Cash flow matters, especially when you're stocking up. We've integrated net terms
directly into checkout — apply once, get approved, and start ordering on credit. No third-party
apps, no invoice chasing. It's built into the system. ### Factory Direct Pricing That Scales This is
the part I'm most proud of. The more you order, the lower your per-unit cost goes — and you see it
in real time as you build your order. We're not hiding pricing behind a "call for quote" wall.
Everything is transparent: 8oz, 10oz, 12oz, blank or custom printed, kraft or white. Pick your size,
pick your quantity, see your price. ### Now Open to Everyone — Not Just Wholesale This was a big
one. We used to be strictly bulk orders, which meant if you needed 25 cups for your kid's birthday
party or a small office event, you were out of luck. Not anymore. Our new system is powered by a
full business management platform running on our own servers — and it handles everything from a
25-cup retail order to a 10,000-cup wholesale run. Same factory direct pricing structure, same
quality, just scaled to what you actually need. Whether you're a restaurant stocking up for the

### Big News — We're Expanding to Los Angeles

][31]

We heard you. Every order, every reorder, every phone call asking if we can handle more volume — we
heard all of it. And first, thank you. Your business is the reason we're able to say what I'm about
to say. We're opening a second facility in Los Angeles. 60,000 square feet. Our manufacturing roots
will always be in Huntington Beach — Surf City USA. It would probably help if I actually knew how to
surf, but hey, you never know. Maybe one day. ### What This Means for Our Capacity Right now, our
Huntington Beach facility is dialed in for short-run printing and custom orders. That's not
changing. If you're ordering 25 custom cups for your event or a few hundred for your coffee shop,
your order is still coming off the same production line, same quality, same team. No interruption.
The LA facility is a different animal. We're bringing in new cup-forming machines that are on
another level — German-engineered equipment built for speed and precision. We're adding a web press
for high-volume runs: franchises, national hotel chains, large-scale retail. And we're going to
die-cut our own cardstock in-house, which means we control every step from raw material to finished
product under our own roof. ### A National Retailer Picked Us Up I can't name them yet — NDA keeps
that under wraps for now. But a very well-known national retailer has started carrying our food
containers in their stores. That's all I can say right now. When the time comes, you'll hear about
it here first. ### New Trade Department for Brokers This one's been a long time coming. We're
building a dedicated Trade Department specifically for brokers and resellers. Special pricing tiers,
dedicated support, marketing tools, templates, tutorials — everything you need to sell our products
under your own operation. If you're a broker or distributor, this is going to be your lane. ### Jobs
and Growth This expansion means jobs. Real ones. We're going to be hiring across the board —
production, logistics, quality control, sales. Growing the team is something I take seriously. The
people who build this stuff every day are the backbone of this company, and bringing more folks into
the operation is one of the best parts of scaling up. ### AI and Robotics on the Production Floor
Last thing, and this one matters to me personally. We're investing in AI-powered quality control —
systems that can identify defects the human eye misses. Consistency at scale is everything in
manufacturing, and this technology makes sure every single unit meets spec before it ships. We're
also bringing in robotic systems for the most dangerous tasks on the floor. If a machine can handle
the job that puts a person at risk, then the machine should be doing it. Period. The goal is simple:
better products, safer people. ### What's Next We're not slowing down. Huntington Beach stays home
base. LA gives us the muscle to compete at the national level. And we're going to keep building this
company the same way we started — factory direct, no middlemen, transparent pricing, and quality you
can hold in your hand. Stay tuned. — Aram US Paper Cup Factory Huntington Beach, CA

*About Us* Company Profile
Founded in 2014,Xiamen ZiHeng Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of eco
packaging products located in Xiamen,Fujian,China.Our products mainly include: Kraft paper salad
bowls, soup cups, white paper bowls, aluminum foil paper bowls,single/ripple paper cups and paper
lids.   Our kraft papers are imported from the United States, all materials are food grade according
to the world standards. We have passed QS and got SDS,FDA,EU,CE,LFGB and other Certificates .Our
produces have been exported to more than 100 countries . Ziheng focuses on the production of paper
bowls, and our equipment is always being updated. Now we have more than 100 sets of the latest
production equipment including : automatic die-cutting machines; various of single/double PE
automatic high-speed paper bowls machines ; paper cups machines; injection molding machines;
full-automatic package machines and other advanced equipment.Our production capacity allows us to
produce and deliver up to 50,000,000 products a day.  We have participated in many exhibitions at
home and abroad. Company principle: Customer first, Quality first, Integrity first. We would like to
deliver our best product and service to our customer around the world and cooperation are warmly
welcome.
